scope: Long-cycle development evidence for three previously identified articles. Published/review endpoint cues were already seen; all remain development only.

candidates.endpoint_cue: Secondary review 75.11% at 5000; check cell and test against primary
Secondary review about 80% at 10000; check cell and test against primary
Primary 3E 84.6% at 10000 and 10 A/g; intermediate-decay development comparator, separate the 2E device tests

evidence_order: Check primary figure attribution, accepted manuscript and companion data. If raw original is absent, use bounded reproducible plotted marks, test identity, same-curve normalization and retained readout uncertainty. A dense solid line alone does not imply observed points.
eligibility: Require at least three distinct positive early observations in the approved window, same-test sample, 3E/2E, reported current and horizon; source grouping and any contradictions preserved. Missing current mass denominator follows existing reported-current contract. No label, scope, or window change. If qualified, stage one evidence-bound development input for the next separately frozen fit; if not, record exact missing item.
boundaries: No new fits, blind prediction lock, canonical admission, or independent acceptance in this round. Protect the latest model and data snapshots.
